# Science Mission Impact

> NASA science mission costs, tracked publications, and citations from The Planetary Society.

Data snapshot: 2026-11-06. Use the export manifest for the dataset version and file inventory.
Active Mission Window and Lifetime are distinct measurement scopes. Base mission and division URLs show the active window; append lifetime/ for lifetime measurements. Each view is available as static HTML.
CSV mission summaries include both scopes. Read the dictionary before comparing costs or aggregating publications: missing values differ from zero, and a publication can be associated with more than one mission.

## Research
- [Overview](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/): Study context and interactive exploration.
- [Analysis](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/analysis/): The authors’ findings and supporting evidence.
- [Methods](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/methods/): Selection, measurement windows, limitations, and sources.

## Data and reuse
- [Downloads](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/download/): CSV downloads, data dictionary, and dataset citation.
- [Manifest](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/data/exports/manifest.json): File URLs, sizes, row counts, versions, and mission pages.
- [Data dictionary](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/data/exports/dictionary.json): Field definitions, units, scopes, and source terms.
- [Citation and license](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/download/#citation): CC BY 4.0 for TPS’s original contributions; third-party terms are identified separately.

## Divisions
- [Astrophysics: Active Mission Window](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/astrophysics/): Mission comparisons in the active window.
- [Astrophysics: Lifetime](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/astrophysics/lifetime/): Lifetime measurements and mission links.
- [Biological & Physical Sciences: Active Mission Window](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/biological-physical/): Mission comparisons in the active window.
- [Biological & Physical Sciences: Lifetime](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/biological-physical/lifetime/): Lifetime measurements and mission links.
- [Earth Science: Active Mission Window](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/earth/): Mission comparisons in the active window.
- [Earth Science: Lifetime](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/earth/lifetime/): Lifetime measurements and mission links.
- [Heliophysics: Active Mission Window](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/heliophysics/): Mission comparisons in the active window.
- [Heliophysics: Lifetime](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/heliophysics/lifetime/): Lifetime measurements and mission links.
- [Planetary Science: Active Mission Window](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/planetary/): Mission comparisons in the active window.
- [Planetary Science: Lifetime](https://dashboards.planetary.org/science-mission-impact/planetary/lifetime/): Lifetime measurements and mission links.
